intro: Football, sepak takraw and pétanque (a French bowls game) are popular in Laos.

chapters.title: Popular sports
text: Pétanque, brought by the French, is played everywhere. Muay Lao is a kickboxing style like Muay Thai.

chapters.title: Events
text: Vientiane hosted the 2009 SEA Games, the biggest sports event ever held in Laos.

keyTerms.meaning: A game of throwing metal balls close to a small target.

places.title: Famous venues
places.intro: Where Laos' biggest sporting moments happen.

items.text: Fast trains link Vientiane with China.
